. Several Arctic cables in or adjacent to the Arctic have experienced major damage in recent years: Cables used for scientific observation off the coast of Western Norway and cables connecting Svalbard to the Norwegian mainland were severed in November 2021 and January 2022, respectively.104

. Subsea cables in the CAO would be somewhat protected by the geography and remoteness of the ocean floor. Accidental disruption of undersea cables in the CAO because of ships’ anchors would be difficult because of its depth and seasonal ice cover. However, these factors also make cable repair difficult because moving ice challenges a repair ship’s ability to remain stationary over the cable.
